whole_peak.qualification: Temporal association only. Plus-time states and contacts are future relative to peak; not causal inputs. Force values are sampled wrench norms, not impulse.

postcontact_peak.qualification: Temporal association only. Plus-time states and contacts are future relative to peak; not causal inputs. Force values are sampled wrench norms, not impulse.

phase_sensitivity.limitation: Only saved 50Hz values exist. Shifting interpolation or decimating cannot reproduce a different 50Hz sensor acquisition phase or recover unsampled peaks.
